weight-medium.$description: medium font weight; softened from Tailwind 500

weight-semibold.$description: semibold font weight; softened from Tailwind 600

weight-bold.$description: bold font weight; softened from Tailwind 700

bg1.$description: default canvas / app backdrop + active chat window

pane-bg.$description: contextual chat-pane surface; bg1 on every pane

bg1-raised.$description: one raised step between bg1 and bg2: composer, cards, settings groups, review threads, docked surfaces

bg1-raised-hover.$description: hover on bg1-raised rows and controls

bg2-hover.$description: hover on bg2; clears a visible step on bg2 and stays below selected-bg

selected-bg.$description: selected, pressed and active fill, one step above hover; never an edge

fg3.$description: the third tier: metadata, placeholders, times, hints; hovered or selected rows lift it to fg2

nav-bg-hover.$description: workspace navigation row hover and selected state

scrollbar-thumb.$description: every scrollbar's thumb, shown while its scroller is hovered or scrolled

scrollbar-size.$description: scrollbar slot, and the thumb under the pointer

scrollbar-thumb-inset.$description: each side of the resting 4px thumb inside its slot

highlighted-bright.$description: structural neutral: diff modified marks, terminal selection, tree accent (focus is the accent)

inverted-fg.$description: dark text/icon on the inverted fill

primary-button-bg.$description: filled focal CTA; one per view

red-text.$description: red status words, icons and destructive labels on any plain surface

red-on-bg.$description: text and icons inside a red-bg container

green-text.$description: green status words and icons on any plain surface

green-on-bg.$description: text and icons inside a green-bg container

yellow-text.$description: yellow status words and icons on any plain surface (one yellow for text and graphics)

yellow-on-bg.$description: text and icons inside a yellow-bg container

accent-text.$description: the blue for words: links, file paths, info icons and running marks

accent-bg.$description: tinted info container and link pills

accent-on-bg.$description: text and icons inside an accent-bg container

conflict-current.$description: merge conflict current rows; translucent so selection shows through

conflict-neutral.$description: merge conflict separator, ancestor and accept rows

violet-solid.$description: violet fill carrying violet-solid-fg (component selection badge)

violet-text.$description: violet status words and icons (merged, done) on any plain surface

orange-text.$description: orange status words and dots for work waiting on the user (needs input, plan ready) on any plain surface

violet-on-bg.$description: text and icons inside a violet-bg container

accent.$description: the one accent fill: keyboard focus, checked controls, switch on, slider and progress

accent-fg.$description: marks drawn on the accent fill

diff-addition.$description: diff addition base; pinned so status text changes leave diffs alone

diff-deletion.$description: diff deletion base; pinned so status text changes leave diffs alone

diff-neutral.$description: neutral mixed into diff row fills
